results.description:
Você tem a deep queimadura penetrating through your skin, resulting in a cracked, red ferimento. While on initiative you take 1 fogo dano for every 5 feet of movement. In addition, you take [[/dano 1d4 fogo]] every time you take an action or bonus action. This injury lasts [[1d8]] dias.

Tratamento - A [[/skill medicine 16]] check reduces the duration of this injury by [[1d8]] dias.
results.name: Third Degree queimadura

results.description:
Sweat breaks out on your brow, your pulse is thready, and your muscles feel weak. You take 1 level of &Reference[Exhaustion]{Exhaustion}.

Tratamento - A long rest or the Greater Restoration spell removes this Exhaustion as usual.
results.name: Heat Exhaustion

results.description:
An angry red queimadura flashes over your skin. It's tender and painful to move. While on initiative you take 1 fogo dano per 10 feet of movement. This injury heals in [[1d6]] dias.

Tratamento - A [[/skill medicine 10]] check reduces the duration of this injury by [[1d6]] dias.
results.name: First Degree queimadura

results.description:
It's so hot you feel faint. Your muscles are cramping. It feels as if your blood is about to boil in your body. You take 2 levels of &Reference[Exhaustion]{Exhaustion}.

Tratamento - A long rest or the Greater Restoration spell removes this Exhaustion as usual.

results.description:
Your skin bubbles and blisters as the burning flashes over it. While on initiative you take 1 fogo dano per 5 feet of movement. This injury heals in [[1d8]] dias.

If you attempt to pick up any dropped items, make a Constitution Saving Throw (DC equals half the dano that caused the lesão persistente or 10, whichever number is higher) to brave the heat and retrieve them.
